headline: 2026 "Great Inheritance Era" Has Arrived! Estate Tax Surpasses NT$750 Billion; Multi-Property Families Beware of Children Fighting Over Assets
summary: Taiwan's estate tax has surpassed NT$750 billion as population aging and accumulated household wealth expand the scale of estate transfers.
why: Estate tax revenue and wealth transfers reflect household asset accumulation and shape fiscal planning and demand for estate and wealth-management services.
